subjects.name: Rosenthal Center for Complementary and Alternative Medicine
National Center for Complementary and Alternative Medicine

summary: American heart surgeon Mehmet Oz used his credentials and fame from Oprah and his own TV show, from 2004 on, to promote psychics, energy healing and unproven weight-loss supplements to millions of viewers.

notes: Transcript gives birth year as 1962 (likely mis-transcribed); 1960 used, consistent with age 25 in 1985. Senate hearing is said as 2004 in the transcript but was 2014. main_span starts at 2004 Oprah debut since the host frames the 1990s alt-medicine work as not yet bastardly.
